anyOf.title: AspectMemberFeedPreference
anyOf.description:
User's feed preference to an aspect.

`preferred`: posts in this aspect will also appear in the user's preferred feed

`normal`: posts in this aspect will appear in the user's normal feed

`hidden`: posts in this aspect will not appear in the user's feed

anyOf.title: AspectMemberNotificationPreference
anyOf.description:
User's notification preference to an aspect.

UNUSED

`push`: user will receive push notifications for this aspect

`activity`: user will receive activity notifications for this aspect

`silent`: user will not receive notifications for this aspect
